courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀
related.transfer: 可遷移「非彈性散射與拉曼位移」與「波數軸校正與應力量測靈敏度」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Inelastic scattering and the Raman shift" and "Wavenumber-axis calibration and stress sensitivity" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦拉曼位移、共軛焦取樣、瑞利光抑制、光柵色散、波數校正與雷射加熱預算；傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀則以麥克森干涉儀、氦氖取樣、解析度與訊雜比交換的 FTIR 工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on raman shift, confocal sampling, Rayleigh rejection, grating dispersion, wavenumber calibration and laser-heating budgets; Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers centres on michelson interferometer, HeNe sampling, resolution and signal-to-noise trade-offs in FTIR engineering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「雷射線與斯托克斯散射光」與「麥克森干涉儀與干涉圖」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「雜訊、掃描次數與解析度的交換」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Laser line and Stokes-scattered light” and “Michelson interferometer and interferogram”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Noise, scan averaging and the resolution trade", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 共軛焦顯微鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「非彈性散射與拉曼位移」與「波數軸校正與應力量測靈敏度」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；共軛焦顯微鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Inelastic scattering and the Raman shift" and "Wavenumber-axis calibration and stress sensitivity" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Confocal microscopy must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦拉曼位移、共軛焦取樣、瑞利光抑制、光柵色散、波數校正與雷射加熱預算；共軛焦顯微鏡則以針孔艾里單位、光學切片厚度、光子預算與雷射掃描系統的校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on raman shift, confocal sampling, Rayleigh rejection, grating dispersion, wavenumber calibration and laser-heating budgets; Confocal microscopy centres on pinhole Airy units, optical-section thickness, photon budgets and calibration of laser-scanning systems, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「雷射線與斯托克斯散射光」與「共軛焦針孔與艾里斑」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到共軛焦顯微鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「折射率失配、球差與軸向誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Laser line and Stokes-scattered light” and “Confocal pinhole and Airy disc”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Confocal microscopy, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Index mismatch, spherical aberration and the axial error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 拉曼顯微光譜儀
history.text: 1928 年 C. V. Raman 與 K. S. Krishnan 在加爾各答以濾過的太陽光與汞燈觀察到液體的非彈性散射，同年 Landsberg 與 Mandelstam 在莫斯科於石英中獨立發現同一效應，Raman 於 1930 年獲諾貝爾物理獎。1960 年代雷射讓拉曼光譜成為實用技術，1975 年 Delhaye 與 Dhamelincourt 在法國里爾發表雷射拉曼微探針，由 Jobin Yvon（今 HORIBA）商品化；1990 年代 CCD、全像陷波濾光片與共軛焦設計讓拉曼顯微光譜儀成為材料、半導體應力與製藥分析的日常工具。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1928 C. V. Raman and K. S. Krishnan in Calcutta observed inelastic scattering from liquids using filtered sunlight and mercury lamps, while Landsberg and Mandelstam in Moscow independently found the same effect in quartz that year, and Raman received the 1930 Nobel Prize in Physics. Lasers made Raman spectroscopy practical in the 1960s, and in 1975 Delhaye and Dhamelincourt in Lille published the laser Raman microprobe that Jobin Yvon, now HORIBA, commercialised; in the 1990s CCDs, holographic notch filters and confocal designs made the Raman microspectrometer a routine tool for materials, semiconductor stress and pharmaceutical analysis. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「非彈性散射與拉曼位移」到「性能驗收與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Inelastic scattering and the Raman shift" through "Performance acceptance and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
